decisions.quote:
In
a conceptual replication of Jokela et al. (2016), results closely
resembled the original study: sleep problems, energy level, and
weight/appetite changes were associated with CRP (2a).
decisions.location: Original-specific primary comparison, raw chars[28774,28961); complete exact primary slice
decisions.reason: In the designated conceptual replication of Jokela et al. (2016) (Model 2a), the authors report that their results closely resembled the original study by recovering the same three symptom associations with CRP. The shipped outcome was based on results from the exploratory 38-variable full models (Models 3b and 4) rather than the replication model.
